name: mischafierz/polyglot-cms
description: A CMS for websites: Go content API, PHP themes, TypeScript admin panel, SQLite storage.

post-create-project-cmd: @php -r "echo PHP_EOL, 'Polyglot CMS is ready. Next steps (needs Go >= 1.22 and Node >= 18):', PHP_EOL, '  composer build   # compile the admin panel and the API', PHP_EOL, '  composer api     # start the API on :8080 (admin at /admin/)', PHP_EOL, '  composer serve   # start the website on :8000', PHP_EOL, 'Or simply: docker compose up --build', PHP_EOL;"

scripts-descriptions.build: Install and compile the TypeScript admin panel and fetch the Go API's dependencies
scripts-descriptions.api: Start the Go content API on :8080
